visual.name: reportingGantt
visual.description: Reporting Gantt — generic timeline visual for Power BI. Activity swim lanes, chevron time axis, milestone markers with conditional left/right labels, optional per-row Notes shown on hover for activities and milestones. Data-driven: any swim-lane names, any milestone-type names (cap 2 types / 8 lanes). Per-value color overrides via Format pane, per-type symbol/size/color/visibility controls, customizable Title card, full font controls on every text element, structured tooltips with header + dates + note section.

dataRoles.name: activity
dataRoles.description: The bar's identity. Each unique value renders as one horizontal bar (e.g., a project task, a campaign phase, a product release, an audit cycle).

dataRoles.name: area
dataRoles.description: Optional grouping that segments bars into swim lanes (e.g., team, department, workstream, portfolio area).

dataRoles.name: startDate
dataRoles.description: When the bar starts. Date column.

dataRoles.name: endDate
dataRoles.description: When the bar ends. Date column.

dataRoles.name: milestoneActivity
dataRoles.description: FK to the parent activity name. Each milestone attaches to the bar with the matching name.

dataRoles.name: milestoneDate
dataRoles.description: When the milestone marker is placed on its parent bar.

dataRoles.name: milestoneType
dataRoles.description: Marker classifier — distinct values appear as one slice each in the Format pane (color/symbol/size/visibility per type).

dataRoles.name: milestoneLabel
dataRoles.description: Optional milestone text (nullable). Shown next to the marker per Label Position.

dataRoles.name: labelPosition
dataRoles.description: L | R | none. Author-controlled position of the label relative to the marker. Use 'none' to hide a single milestone's label without affecting others (per-row hide mechanism).

dataRoles.name: activityNote
dataRoles.description: Optional per-activity status note (free text). Shown in the activity tooltip on hover. Source: a text column on the Activities table — typically a 'Status' or 'Notes' column.

dataRoles.name: milestoneNote
dataRoles.description: Optional per-milestone status note (free text). Shown in the milestone tooltip on hover. Source: a text column on the Milestones table.

title.description: Power BI's built-in platform title. Off by default — use the Chart Title card below instead for richer styling. Turning this on shows the title as a separate text element above the visual viewport (PBI platform handles rendering).

chartTitle.description: Custom title rendered inside the visual at the top — independent from Power BI's built-in 'Title' card. Use this for a styled, presentation-quality title. To avoid two titles, turn the built-in Title card OFF when using Chart Title.

tooltip.description: Controls hover-tooltip behavior. The Note row appears in both activity and milestone tooltips; this card decides whether to show it and how to handle rows where the Note field is unbound or empty.

layout.description: Outer margins around the chart, as percentages of viewport.

milestones.description: Marker + label controls. Max 2 milestone types (cap-2). First 2 distinct values from data bind to slots 1 and 2; displayNames in Format pane show actual type names. Data with 3+ types drops the extras.

swimlanes.description: Width, label styling, and per-swim-lane color overrides — all consolidated here. One color picker appears per distinct Swim Lane value found in your data.

useAreaColor.displayName: Use swim lane color for label

timeAxis.description: Three hierarchy levels — Year, Quarter, Month. Each level can be toggled on/off. Quarter and Month tick boundaries can also render vertical gridlines through the chart body with their own color, opacity, and line style.
